document.about: Lutron Maestro specification submittal 369613a. Its pages set three columns of product tables and notes, and lines that run across the page, a note or the trademark statement, end just past a column's edge.

notes: #266: a line's full stop, set just past the column edge the line's last word stopped at, was cut off into a paragraph of its own: the rejoin of a line a column edge bisected compared the pieces' tops, and a full stop's top is the baseline.

checks.issue: #266: the trademark statement on p5 lost its final full stop to a paragraph `.`.

element.text: Lutron, the Lutron logo, Maestro, Hi-lume, LED+, C)L, Claro, and FASS are trademarks or registered trademarks of Lutron Electronics Co., Inc. in the US and/or other countries. All other product names, logos, and brands are property of their respective owners.
